description: Central Province - Appointed Mr. T. M. P. S. B. Tennakoon as Asst. Secretary to the Ministry of Road Development, etc. and 08 other Officers and Mr. H. M. M. U. B. Herath to overlook the Post of Director of the Department of Tourism w.e.f. 16.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (specific named individuals being appointed to positions like S.L.A.S. III, S.L.E.S. I, etc.) with basic titles and no detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or ministerial functions. The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed to which positions without outlining what those positions are responsible for in terms of subject areas or government functions.
